title: Equality and truthiness
description: Study equality and truthiness with a self-contained Node.js ESM debugging exercise, runnable student starter, tested instructor solution and official references.
objectives: Explain the equality and truthiness behavior using a runnable example
Reproduce the starter defect and repair it with tested JavaScript
Verify ordinary, edge and invalid inputs without mutating unrelated state
rubric: I can explain the underlying equality and truthiness rule, not only paste code.
I demonstrate a red starter and a green instructor solution with meaningful input assertions.
I preserve input data or state boundaries and document an untested case.
